name: io.github.lightsmith-photonics/lightsmith
title: Lightsmith
description: Open photonics simulation: Mie, DDA, FDTD, TMM, RCWA, mode, EME, FDFD, band and circuit solvers.

environmentVariables.name: LIGHTSMITH_MCP_MAX_MEMORY_GB
environmentVariables.description: Refuse solves estimated to need more memory than this (default 8)

environmentVariables.name: LIGHTSMITH_MCP_MAX_RUNTIME_S
environmentVariables.description: Refuse solves estimated to run longer than this (default 1800)

environmentVariables.name: LIGHTSMITH_CLOUD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Run solves on Lightsmith Cloud instead of locally

environmentVariables.name: LIGHTSMITH_MATERIALS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Lightsmith Materials API base URL for material search
